summary: This clinical trial studied the effect of the drug AZD0780 combined with rosuvastatin on cholesterol levels in adults with dyslipidaemia, a condition marked by an abnormal amount of lipids in the blood. Researchers wanted to see how the medication affected low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, which is often called bad cholesterol. The study has been Completed and involved 76 participants. AstraZeneca sponsored the trial.
